_about.corpus: Latest 10-K and 10-Q for AAPL, MSFT, NVDA as filed on SEC EDGAR (fetched 2026-08-26).
_about.authoring: Every gold figure was read directly out of the cleaned filing text in data/processed, not from memory or an external source. `evidence` regexes define which retrieved chunks count as relevant for recall/MRR/nDCG. Numeric evidence accepts either rendering a filing may use - the tabulated figure (215,938) or the MD&A prose form ($215.9 billion) - since both genuinely answer the question; matching only the former understated retrieval scores.
_about.behaviour: answer = must produce a cited answer; refuse = must decline (fact is outside the corpus); clarify = underspecified, must either decline or explicitly flag the ambiguity.
_about.note: Fiscal years differ by issuer: Apple FY2025 ended 2025-09-27, Microsoft FY2026 ended 2026-06-30, NVIDIA FY2026 ended 2026-01-25. Several questions exist specifically to test whether the system keeps those periods straight.

questions.question: What were Apple's total net sales in fiscal 2025?
questions.gold: Apple reported total net sales of $416,161 million for fiscal 2025, up 6% from $391,035 million in fiscal 2024.

questions.question: How much revenue did Apple's Services segment generate in fiscal 2025, and how did it change year over year?
questions.gold: Services net sales were $109,158 million in fiscal 2025, up 14% from $96,169 million in fiscal 2024.

questions.question: What were Apple's net sales in Greater China in fiscal 2025 and did they grow?
questions.gold: Greater China net sales were $64,377 million in fiscal 2025, a 4% decline from $66,952 million in fiscal 2024. It was Apple's only reporting segment to shrink.

questions.question: How much did Apple spend on research and development in fiscal 2025, and what percentage of net sales was that?
questions.gold: Apple spent $34,550 million on research and development in fiscal 2025, up 10% year over year, representing 8% of total net sales.

questions.question: What was Apple's total gross margin in fiscal 2025, split between Products and Services?
questions.gold: Total gross margin was $195,201 million in fiscal 2025: $112,887 million from Products and $82,314 million from Services.

questions.question: What was Microsoft's total revenue for fiscal year 2026?
questions.gold: Microsoft reported total revenue of $331,839 million for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, up from $281,724 million in fiscal 2025.

questions.question: How does Microsoft split its fiscal 2026 revenue between Product and Service and other?
questions.gold: For fiscal 2026 Microsoft reported $64,696 million of Product revenue and $267,143 million of Service and other revenue, totalling $331,839 million.

questions.question: What was NVIDIA's revenue for fiscal year 2026 and how much did it grow?
questions.gold: NVIDIA reported revenue of $215,938 million for the fiscal year ended January 25, 2026, up 65% from $130,497 million in fiscal 2025.

questions.question: What was NVIDIA's gross margin in fiscal 2026 and how did it move versus the prior year?
questions.gold: NVIDIA's gross margin was 71.1% in fiscal 2026, down 3.9 percentage points from 75.0% in fiscal 2025.

questions.question: What was NVIDIA's operating income and net income in fiscal 2026?
questions.gold: NVIDIA reported operating income of $130,387 million (up 60%) and net income of $120,067 million (up 65%) in fiscal 2026.

questions.question: What was Microsoft's total revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026?
questions.gold: Microsoft reported total revenue of $82,886 million for the three months ended March 31, 2026, versus $70,066 million a year earlier.

questions.question: What were NVIDIA's total operating expenses in fiscal 2026?
questions.gold: NVIDIA's operating expenses were $23,076 million in fiscal 2026, up 41% year over year.

questions.question: How much revenue did Apple's iPhone product line generate in fiscal 2025?
questions.gold: iPhone net sales were $209,586 million in fiscal 2025, up 4% from $201,183 million in fiscal 2024.

questions.question: Which company had higher total annual revenue in its most recent fiscal year, Microsoft or NVIDIA, and by how much?
questions.gold: Microsoft, at $331,839 million for FY2026 (ended June 30, 2026), versus NVIDIA at $215,938 million for FY2026 (ended January 25, 2026) - a difference of about $115,901 million. Note the fiscal years are not aligned.

questions.question: Compare Apple's and NVIDIA's most recent full-year revenue.
questions.gold: Apple reported $416,161 million of net sales for fiscal 2025 (ended September 27, 2025); NVIDIA reported $215,938 million of revenue for fiscal 2026 (ended January 25, 2026). Apple is roughly 1.9x NVIDIA.

questions.question: Which of the three companies in this corpus grew revenue fastest in its latest fiscal year?
questions.gold: NVIDIA, at 65% growth (to $215,938 million in FY2026), well ahead of Microsoft (about 18%, to $331,839 million) and Apple (6%, to $416,161 million).

questions.question: How does R&D intensity compare between Apple and NVIDIA in their latest fiscal years?
questions.gold: Apple's R&D was $34,550 million in fiscal 2025, about 8% of net sales. NVIDIA's R&D was 8.6% of revenue in fiscal 2026, down from 9.9% the prior year. The two are comparable as a share of revenue.

questions.question: What was revenue last year?
questions.gold: Underspecified: the corpus holds three issuers with three different fiscal calendars. The system should ask which company (and which fiscal year), or answer for all three with each period stated explicitly.

questions.question: How much did they spend on research and development?
questions.gold: Underspecified: no company named. The system should ask which issuer rather than silently picking one.

questions.question: What was the gross margin percentage?
questions.gold: Underspecified: company and period both missing. NVIDIA's FY2026 gross margin of 71.1% is the most prominent match, but answering with it unqualified would be wrong.

questions.question: What is Apple's revenue forecast for fiscal 2027?
questions.gold: Must refuse. Apple does not publish forward revenue guidance in its 10-K, so this is not in the corpus.

questions.question: How much did Tesla spend on research and development in 2025?
questions.gold: Must refuse. Tesla is not in this corpus, which covers only AAPL, MSFT and NVDA.

questions.question: What was the total compensation package of Microsoft's CEO in fiscal 2026?
questions.gold: Must refuse. Item 11 (Executive Compensation) is incorporated by reference to the proxy statement and its figures are not present in the 10-K itself. This is the hardest refusal in the set: the section heading exists in the corpus and retrieves well, but contains no numbers.

questions.question: What price did NVIDIA pay to acquire Intel's foundry business?
questions.gold: Must refuse. No such transaction appears in the filings; the premise is false. The system must not confabulate a figure to satisfy the question's assumption.
